The '''Enferm system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mezeg sector/Legends|Mezeg sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Enferm]].
